body: NewRoleClient/RoleCredentials and DSN role_arn/external_id/role_session_name/role_duration. ExternalID is required (confused-deputy guard) and SessionName required (CloudTrail); Duration defaults to 1h (STS default). Credentials: stscreds assume-role provider in aws.CredentialsCache with a 1-minute expiry window, wrapped in a pointer type whose String/GoString/Format print only role+session. Set on s3.Options.Credentials (not config.WithCredentialsProvider, which would wrap another cache). The DSN's other credential params are the app's own, used only for STS. Opening calls Retrieve once so a bad role/external ID is CodePermission at start-up. External ID may sit in the DSN (AWS does not treat it as secret) but never appears in errors or prints.
title: S3 bring-your-own-bucket: RoleOptions with required ExternalID, renewing CredentialsCache, role assumed once at open
